biological.citation: Identifying Novel Osteoarthritis-Associated Genes in Human Cartilage Using a Systematic Meta-Analysis and a Multi-Source Integrated Network (PMID: 35457215)
biological.summary: ARPC4-TTLL3 was identified as one of five novel osteoarthritis-associated proteins. It emerged from a ranked multi-source network of 1689 genes built from a meta-analysis of differentially expressed mRNAs and miRNAs, miRNA targets and SNP datasets. Mass spectrometry of superficial, middle and deep zones of human osteoarthritic cartilage compared with normal controls confirmed it at the protein level, alongside PPIB, ASS1, LHDB and TPI1. The abstract does not state the direction of change or any mechanism for ARPC4-TTLL3.
